for: Quarterdeck final build, EV-7 test: a card whose Page has no file and that cites six evidence items, so the phone folds at three slots
author: Quarterdeck contributors
rules: Test-only: loaded only by the build's test mode, never in the example data, never in anything shown to the Captain as example content.

The fixture is a taskCards entry in the example data's shape plus its 'evidence' record in the evidence.json shape, plus one fixture-only Page record in the example data's pages shape ('pages'). Paths are relative to this file's folder.

Fixture-only records are listed in 'fixtureOnly': the card ev7-card and the Page PG-901 (numbers from 900 up are never in the example data). AR-1 and MT-101 are the example data's own records: this card cites them and copies or changes nothing in them. In the example data they belong to alba-1.
The three pictures are the numbered test pictures in ../theme-sweep/evidence/media, the same files EV-1 in theme-sweep/evidence-fixtures.v2.json uses; they say 'Test fixture only' on them.

Order of the evidence items is the C-6 order built on main (the design lead's 1:47 PM calls): the pictures of the 'media' list first, in list order (and any video), then the Page, the Artifact and the Mail. For EV-7 that is picture 1, picture 2, picture 3, PG-901, AR-1, MT-101.

The expectations are the design lead's calls of Tue Nov 3, 1:47 PM (the design lead's review), and the ruling and the design spec lines where they still hold. Each expectation says which. None is left as a suggestion.
Bot names in 'by' and 'doneBy' are display names (bots[].name in the example data).

fixtures.fixture: EV-7 Page with no file, six items, the phone folds at three tiles
expect: Phone and upright iPad: 3 slots (the design lead's 1:47 PM calls). The card cites 6 items, in the C-6 order: picture 1, picture 2, picture 3, Page PG-901, Artifact AR-1, Mail MT-101. They show as 2 items, picture 1 and picture 2 (the media list, the design spec 4.3, line 243), and a third tile that reads '+4 more'. N is 6 minus the 2 items shown, which is 4; picture 3, PG-901, AR-1 and MT-101 are the 4 not shown.

Sideways iPad and Mac: 6 slots (the design lead's 1:47 PM calls; the ruling, gives the Mac 6). The card cites exactly 6 items, so all six show, in the same order, and there is no '+N more' tile. The Artifact tile (AR-1) draws its first 3 lines in mono, then 'log' and 'search-groups-test.log'.

Tapping '+4 more' while the Page has no file (the design lead's 1:47 PM calls) shows every item in the grid, in place, with nothing hidden: all six items, and no '+N more' tile. It does not open Whole card and it does not open the viewer.

The Page tile reads its title, 'Search order notes', and 'No file yet', and is not a link: tapping it opens nothing (the design spec 4.3, line 237; the design lead's 1:47 PM calls). In the grid it comes after the pictures (C-6 order).
No 'See all on Page' shows at the right of the Evidence heading, because PG-901 has no file (the design spec 4.3, line 237; the design lead's 1:47 PM calls). EV-1 tests the state where it shows.
In the full-screen viewer of a picture, 'Open the Page' is hidden, because the Page has no file (the design lead's 1:47 PM calls; the ruling, names the button).

how: One fixture, EV-7, asked for during review: until now no fixture had a card that cites a Page with no file and enough items to fold. EV-1's PG-1 has a file; F-1 to F-5 cite at most three items; after item 5, PG-2 has a file too.

The card ev7-card and the Page PG-901 are fixture-only and appear nowhere else. The Page is in the example data's pages shape (ref, projectId, title, by, updatedAt, live, file) with file null. check-ev7.py recomputes the six items, the tile text sources and N from the example data.

The expectations in 'expect' are the design lead's calls of Tue Nov 3, 1:47 PM and the ruling and the design spec lines where they still hold, each cited. The spec's older drawing of three tiles on the Mac gives way to C-6, per the design lead. check-ev7.py reads the cited lines and checks the words each expectation relies on.

Times are ISO with -05:00 and are at or before the example 'now' (Mon Nov 2, 10:00 AM ET); only the card's due (Thu Nov 5, 12:00 PM) is later. All are after Sun Nov 1, 2:00 AM, so -05:00 is the real offset.
